name: SMACS J0638.7-5358 (Hubble)
blurb: SMACS J0638.7-5358, a galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: smacsj063875358-hubble
story: A massive gathering of galaxies, one of the extreme clusters Hubble surveyed in quick snapshot exposures. Radio telescopes find a diffuse halo of radio emission spread through the cluster.

claims.text: SMACS J0638.7-5358 is a target of Hubble program 16670, a snapshot survey of extreme galaxy clusters
The survey targets truly massive galaxy clusters
A galaxy cluster at this position is ACT-CL J0638-5358, alternate ID AS0592
The cluster J0638.7-5358 hosts a radio halo
